caption: A glowing electric heater is unplugged, and the orange glow of its elements fades to dark.

sa.check: An electric heater with elements glowing orange.
The elements are glowing before the pull.
The order is glowing, unplug, fading.

pc.expect: The glow begins to fade after the plug leaves the socket, not before; any fan stops at once.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the elements stay at full glow to the end of the clip; or the glow fades before the plug moves; or the glow fades with the plug still seated; or the fan runs on with the plug out.

pc.expect: The fade runs one way, from bright orange through dull red toward dark, and never brightens again; it is gradual, not a switch-off.
pc.fail: The elements brighten after unplugging; or go dark and return; or pulse; or the glow goes out instantly like a lamp and the elements show no dull red.

pc.expect: The whole element follows the same one-way fade; the glow does not skip about.
pc.fail: One part of an element goes dark while another brightens; or the glow moves along the element like a travelling light; or a dark element relights.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free; the heater stays put.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or the heater is dragged over by the pull.

pc.expect: One heater, one cord, one plug, one socket; the elements keep their shape; the plug leaves the socket whole.
pc.fail: An element vanishes rather than going dark; or the plug passes through the wall; or the cord splits; or the heater changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The heater's casing, the grille and the room stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the grille pattern changes; or the room's contents rearrange.

note: How fast the glow fades and how far it has faded by the end are not judged, only that it fades one way after the pull.
